== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴドライバー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する戦闘用ビークルの戦闘力に２を加える。戦闘用ビークルがＡＴ－ＡＴなら２ではなく３を加える。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">戦場を遥かに見下ろしつつウォーカーを駆るＡＴ－ＡＴドライバーたちは、厚さ15cmの強化装甲板で護られているため、歩兵たちからは臆病者と軽蔑されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — AT-AT Driver.

'''Lore''' — AT-AT drivers pilot their walkers high above the battlefield. The infantry scorn them as cowards because 15 centimeters of reinforced armor protect them.

'''Game text''' — Add 2 to the power of any combat vehicle this character pilots. If the combat vehicle is an AT-AT, add 3 instead of 2.

Both cards give the same power bonuses. The Japanese lore explicitly says the infantry regard the drivers as cowards.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-atatdriver.gif|Original English face]], [[AT-AT Driver]].</ref>
